project.title: Ilustrado
project.description: A WIP novel I have been trying to write for sometime now. All the details are saved in Notion with a huge catalogue of references and personal research, and a huge library of concepts, ideas and world-building I have done throughout the years. It has gotten through multiple changes in genres from historical fiction, speculative fiction to fantasy fiction because it often depended on the last thing I watched that left me inspired. Whoops! Nevertheless, what I have gather have been quite substantial and I really need to get back to writing those chapters.
